title: Stress Level Checker
description: The real 10-item Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10) with standard scoring bands.
howto: Answer all 10 questions about the last month honestly.
Use the scale from Never (0) to Very often (4).
Read your score out of 40 and the low / moderate / high band.

faqs.a: 0-13 is considered low stress, 14-26 moderate, 27-40 high perceived stress, using the standard PSS-10 bands.
Four items are worded positively, so 'Very often' on those means less stress. They are reverse-scored automatically.
No. It is a screening tool that measures perceived stress, not a medical or psychological diagnosis.
